name: ev-hypothesis-playground
description: Create and test reproducible EV charging hypotheses with a reduced pandapower network.

interface.shortDescription: Reproducible EV charging experiments and counterexamples
interface.longDescription: Define charging hypotheses, freeze scenarios, run the small pandapower model and compare electrical and vehicle-service outcomes. Includes an agent workflow skill and a local MCP server backed by your project checkout.
